description: Change any of: timezone (IANA name, e.g. Europe/Madrid; it sets where each day starts and ends), workplace (the default for sessions; reminders go to every device), stand-up interval workMin, breakMin, longBreakEvery, longBreakMin, standup on/off, post_to (networks for progress posts), tracking (time, moves or quiet), weekly_target (days a week toward the aim) and weekly_review_email (on/off).

post_to.description: which connected networks get the day's progress post (the app sets it); [] for none

tracking.description: time (default): sessions with minutes, plus moves. moves: no timer and no minutes stored, only moves. quiet: the record is kept, but reviews and posts speak in words and days, never minutes or percentages

weekly_review_email.description: the weekly review AimYear writes from the record, emailed on Sunday at 19:00 in the user's timezone (Pro; default on)

weekly_target.description: days a week the user wants to move toward the aim (default 4)

name: set_settings
title: Set settings
